Welcome to Onewa Road Vet Hospital
We pride ourselves on the exceptional quality of veterinary medicine that we practice.
WE ARE CURRENTLY HAVING ISSUES WITH ONLINE BOOKING NOT SHOWING VETS AVAILABILITY. PLEASE CALL OR EMAIL FOR AN APPOINTMENT IF THE VET YOU WANT IS NOT SHOWING UP ON ONLINE BOOKING.
We take immense pride in the exceptional standard of veterinary medicine we deliver. Our highly experienced team of veterinarians, veterinary technicians, nurses and receptionists is dedicated to providing top-tier care for your beloved pets.
We warmly welcome new clients to our independent veterinary practice, where a large team of veterinarians ensures availability when you need us most. Many of our senior veterinarians have been with the clinic for over 20 years, offering continuity of care and the reassurance of seeing trusted professionals at every visit.
To further enhance our services, we collaborate with specialists both across Auckland and internationally. This allows us to provide tailored solutions that meet a wide range of needs and budgets. Additionally, our team includes veterinarians with extensive expertise in rabbit medicine and surgery, catering to the unique needs of small and exotic pets.
At our clinic, your pet’s health and well-being are always our top priority.

Specials!
Senior Pet Checks
Senior Pet Checks
Senior Pets deserve a little extra love and attention. At Onewa Vets we’ve put together some really affordable blood tests to check out your senior pet. Book in today for a Senior Pet Wellness Check. Early detection leads to better outcomes!
Our Services
We provide a wide range of veterinary services including consultations for dogs, cats, rabbits and other companion animals as well as full surgical services and annual health checks.
We are experienced rabbit vets and Dr. Oliver is a rabbit owner himself.
Consultations
Consultations
Our consultations provide tailored care through thorough exams and planning. Available by appointment weekdays 8 AM–7 PM and Saturdays 9 AM–12 PM. Book online, by phone, or email.
More Details
Surgery
Surgery
Our experienced team performs surgeries weekdays, supported by skilled nurses and advanced facilities. We prioritise expert care and pain management to ensure your pet’s comfort and recovery.
More Details
Diagnostics
Diagnostics
We offer a wide range of in-house diagnostic tests—like blood work, x-rays, and ultrasound—providing fast, accurate results to quickly guide the best treatment for your pet’s health.
More Details
Independently Owned
Independently Owned
We are an independent, veterinarian-owned clinic where the vets who care for your pets are also the owners. We prioritise your experience, deliver exceptional care, and maintain a trusted community reputation.
More Details
Wisdom, Experience, Stability
Wisdom, Experience, Stability
Our veterinary team brings decades of experience, combining expert knowledge with compassionate care. Senior vets with over 20 years at our clinic provide continuity, trusted relationships, and a lasting commitment to excellence.
More Details
Low Stress
Low Stress
We are committed to providing a low-stress, fear-free experience for every pet in our care. Our kennels and cat ward are designed to minimise stress. Pre-visit medications are available to ensure your pet remains relaxed and comfortable.
